structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The safe-sounding ones were מק"מ, government bonds and a "קרן כספית" (low risk, it says), but there's no number anywhere on what they pay or what they charge, and it's a private site, so I'll ask my son and the bank clerk about מק"מ and קרן כספית compared with my deposit.

'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי': I don't know who is behind it, so I don't know whether to believe it
